name: mirage
text: 1) Yes, PropLine has regular game lines: moneyline, spreads and totals (plus period lines like quarters, halves and sets) for every upcoming game, and it grades them. The engine already reads them. 2) The chat: no Claude session was holding the chat seat for the last ~2 hours, so your messages sat unanswered until the wake fired and reached me just now. Sorry. I logged it as CH87 and I'm checking why the wake was slow so it can't repeat. 3) Wins up but total profit down: I can't give the exact cause yet. Likely suspects: the all-time number is your wallet now (cash + open bets at cost) minus money put in, so fees, bets still open, and losses settled from other days or bids move it even when today's settled bets are green. I'm checking the numbers against your wallet now and will tell you what I find.
